UeberUns.headline: Voices from the team
UeberUns.subline: Quotes & positive feedback – straight from the festival tent.

voices.name: Sepp
voices.quote: I pour faster than guests can get thirsty – and that's exactly how it should be.
voices.spruch: A beer without foam is like a festival without brass music.

voices.name: Lena
voices.quote: Tray full, heart full: when the guests laugh, my evening is perfect.
voices.spruch: I carry eight steins at once – just not the responsibility.

voices.name: Michi
voices.quote: From empty field to festival tent in two days – that's our little miracle.
voices.spruch: I don't just set up tents, I set the mood.

voices.name: Anna
voices.quote: When the aroma of roast pork fills the air, guests forget their phones for a moment.
voices.spruch: Love goes through the stomach – with us through the whole hall.

voices.name: Resi
voices.quote: One festival ends and the next begins – and in between, there's always cake at my counter.
voices.spruch: Coffee black, traditional attire colorful, mood golden.

Hero.subtitle: Experience authentic celebrations with a modern twist. From small village festivals to exclusive event gastronomy – we bring the traditional host into the present.

About.title: Welcome to Maurerwirt!
About.subtitle: Bavarian Roots. Modern Celebrations.
About.p1: I am Florian Maurer – known to many simply as "da Maurerwirt". With roots in the Halbauer butchery, I learned early on what quality and genuine hospitality mean. Today, I bring this tradition into the modern event world.
About.p2: Whether it's a traditional folk festival, an elegant company anniversary, or a very personal club party – we combine Bavarian warmth with precise planning and professional equipment.
About.quote: “A good party doesn't plan itself, but it should feel like it does.”
About.p3: Let's work together to create an event that your guests will remember fondly for a long time.
About.hero_intro: I'm Florian – to many simply "da Maurerwirt". My mission: keep tradition alive, give people a great time and make the most of every festival. We only have one life – and we should celebrate it.
About.hero_team: I do enjoy the spotlight – but without my team nothing here would work. Every helping hand, every laugh, every stein of beer: that's the work of people who put their heart into it. So: thank you to everyone who pitches in.

Identity.intro: We don't come from the event industry, we come from the inn parlor and the festival tent. You can feel that in every detail: in our kitchen, our service and our music.
